# Deleting a projection refuses to remove a directory that replaced its workspace.

mkdir definition/layers
mv give/layer definition/layers/0001-base
cd definition
git init -q -b main
exec layerctl projection create demo --worktree $WORK/workspace

# The recorded path now points to another directory with a file to preserve.
mv $WORK/workspace $WORK/original-workspace
mkdir $WORK/workspace
cp $WORK/give/keep.txt $WORK/workspace/keep.txt

! exec layerctl projection delete demo
stderr '^layerctl: refuse to delete composition "demo": '
cmp $WORK/workspace/keep.txt $WORK/give/keep.txt

-- give/layer/layer.toml --
[vcs]
commit-msg = "Start projection"
-- give/keep.txt --
Unrelated file
